channel.title: Flexarion — Studio Engineering Devlog
channel.description: Engineering notes, cel-shading art direction, and procedural audio architecture from independent studio Flexarion (Aix-en-Provence).

item.title: Procedural Audio Architecture and Minimalist Synth Pads
item.description: Lisière: how every puzzle stone drives a live additive synth graph and resonant low-pass filter in Godot 4 and PipeWire.

item.title: Art Direction: Translating Mediterranean Calanques Light into Cel-Shading
item.description: Neon Calanques: building a custom cel-shaded pipeline in Unreal Engine 5 pairing blinding limestone with nocturnal neon emission.

item.title: Generating Wind-Reactive Volumetric Fog in Godot 4
item.description: The Mist Watchers: technical deep dive on 3D Worley-Perlin density shaders, 15 Hz wind vector fields, and lighthouse lighting in Godot 4.3.
